local (d1_server.py) d1-local/LiquidAI/d1-Omni-2B · effort not in the requests

A late entry joins an original league table after it was played and plays every setup of that table once, in matches of its own. Its games count in no standings table, no league table, no Hype Cup input and no other setup's numbers. The numbers here come from its own late-entry games only, computed as for a setup in a league.

Error rate and risk judgement: 95% intervals, whole games resampled. Ability d′ and caution c at the 0.001 margin: rates corrected by adding 0.5 to the counts and 1 to the totals; 95% intervals, blocks of two seat-swapped games resampled. Cut off: answers that stopped at an output limit the request sent (finish reason length, stop reason max_tokens, finishReason MAX_TOKENS, incomplete max_output_tokens), in the stored response or error. Effort: the reasoning effort the requests sent. Engine's best play: the share of its scored decisions that chose the engine's best play (equity loss under the best-play threshold). Time: median request seconds per decision (waits between retries not included). Cost per 1,000 decisions: the recorded tokens at the price shown, as labelled there (list or billed price; for a setup on our GPUs the hosted model's list price, not billed).

no price per token; estimate: GPU time, at most; source content/own_cost.json (wall clock on our machines × hourly rate); price date not recorded
up to 255 options per request; more legal plays are split into equal groups, a winner per group, then among the winners; no decision in this data was split

Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup), late-entry league #53. LiquidAI/d1-Omni-2B @ 81222da, d1-2B with audio added (the card: text, pictures and audio in), on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell of ours (GPU 2, the card d1-2B used, after it), BF16, through logic's d1_server.py: the command of logic's decision/servers.sh d1-omni-2b in d1-2B's environment (torch 2.15.0+cu132, transformers 5.22.1), the card's call model.system_one(state, questions) unchanged, model field LiquidAI/d1-Omni-2B; text only: backgammon positions are text, so its audio and picture inputs are unused; one request at a time; never on a hosted API. Its request and limits are d1-2B's: the model's request code is byte-identical to d1-2B's and its tokenizer only adds two audio tokens, so text prompts tokenize the same. First stage 14 Nov 2026, 19:47–19:50 UTC: its 9 hosted and program opponents (#1437–#1445); local stage 14 Nov 2026, 19:56–20:15 UTC: the 8 setups we run ourselves, one at a time on the same card (#1447–#1454); runner 46c984e throughout. It played 17 of its 19 opponents: its pair with Mercury Decide was not played (Mercury Decide is no longer served on OpenRouter; match #1446 aborted at its warm-up; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov) and its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played (GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov). Every option count gets distinct single-token codes (A..IU at 255). Context 128,000 positions; nothing in its code shortens a prompt, and a request it cannot answer is refused (400), never cut: League 1's longest stored request (251 options) is 20,759 tokens; nothing refused. Its cost is an estimate from its time on the RTX PRO 6000 (GPU time, at most).
